translations.source: Towns CMOS flag at I/O 0x328C. When on, FD1 is unavailable.
translations.translation: Flag CMOS Towns (I/O 0x328C). Activé = FD1 indisponible.

translations.source: Drive letter assignments (A–P). Apply or OK writes VM CMOS RAM and the active CMOS file. Towns OS usually picks them up after reset/boot.
translations.translation: Lettres de lecteur (A–P). Appliquer/OK écrit la CMOS RAM et le fichier CMOS actif. Towns OS : souvent après reset/boot.

translations.source:
Create a sparse image.
Logical size is as entered; disk usage starts small and grows on write.
translations.translation:
Créer une image sparse.
Taille logique saisie ; usage disque faible au début, croît à l’écriture.

translations.source:
Make an existing image sparse by punching holes in zero regions.
Logical size is unchanged; only on-disk usage shrinks.
translations.translation:
Rendre sparse (trous dans les zéros).
Taille logique inchangée ; usage disque réduit.

translations.source: TownsOS: create with 1 partition + format (127 MB, max size)

Writes Towns HD IPL, one full-size partition, and an empty FAT16.
For HD0, CMOS is set to D: = SCSI unit 0 after OK.
Restart the emulator to recognize the drive.
translations.translation:
Écrit IPL HD Towns, une partition pleine et FAT16 vide.
HD0 : CMOS D: = SCSI unit 0 après OK.
Redémarrage requis.

translations.source: New images are created sparse. File managers show logical size; actual disk usage stays small until data is written.
translations.translation: Nouvelles images en sparse. L’explorateur montre la taille logique ; usage réel faible tant qu’on n’écrit pas.

translations.source: Images are stored under %1 by default.
Changes take effect after the emulator is restarted.

Logical size in MB (%1–%2).
Created as a sparse image:
translations.translation:
Taille logique en Mo (%1–%2).
Image sparse :

translations.source:
Create a 127 MB TownsOS image with one full-size partition and an empty format?
For HD0, D: will be set to SCSI unit 0 in CMOS when you press OK.
translations.translation:
Créer une image TownsOS 127 Mo (1 partition, format vide) ?
HD0 : D: = SCSI unit 0 en CMOS à OK.

translations.source: Failed to create the hard disk directory.
The file already exists. Overwrite it?
Failed to create the hard disk image.
Created a TownsOS-formatted sparse hard disk image (1 partition).
translations.translation: Image HD sparse TownsOS créée (1 partition).

translations.source: Created a sparse hard disk image.

Logical size (for FM TOWNS): %1
Disk usage on this computer: %2

File managers list logical size. Use the tooltip on the path field or `du -h` to check disk usage.
translations.translation:
Taille logique (FM TOWNS) : %1
Usage ici : %2

L’explorateur montre la taille logique. Infobulle du chemin ou `du -h` pour l’usage.

translations.source: After OK: CMOS D: = SCSI unit 0 (HD0). Restart to recognize the drive.
translations.translation: Après OK : CMOS D: = SCSI unit 0 (HD0). Redémarrer pour reconnaître.

translations.source: The selected file does not exist.

Failed to compact the hard disk image.
Sparse compaction is supported on Linux with ext4, XFS, or Btrfs.
translations.translation:
Échec compaction.
Sparse sous Linux : ext4, XFS ou Btrfs.

translations.source:
Compacted the hard disk image.
Logical size is unchanged; unused zero regions now use less disk space.
translations.translation:
Image HD compactée.
Taille logique inchangée ; zéros occupent moins d’espace.

translations.source: Show FPS, emulation Hz, and present-queue stats in the window title.
translations.translation: FPS, Hz d’émulation et file present dans le titre.

translations.source: Log CD-ROM commands, CDDA play/stop, and data-sector access.
translations.translation: Journaliser commandes CD, CDDA play/stop et secteurs data.

translations.source: Log guest EXE/EXP identity, MOS session, in-game phase, and mouse apply.
translations.translation: Journaliser EXE/EXP, session MOS, phase et apply souris.

translations.source: Live CPU registers, current instruction, CS:EIP history, and call stack. Enables the core debugger while open.
translations.translation: Registres CPU live, instruction, historique CS:EIP et pile. Active le debugger tant qu’ouvert.

translations.source: HD image created, but failed to set CMOS D: = SCSI unit 0.
translations.translation: Image HD créée, échec CMOS D: = SCSI unit 0.

translations.source: Hard disk settings saved (CMOS D: = SCSI unit 0). Restart to recognize HD0.
translations.translation: Disque dur enregistré (CMOS D: = SCSI unit 0). Redémarrer pour HD0.

translations.source: Hard disk settings saved. They take effect after restart.
translations.translation: Disque dur enregistré. Effet après redémarrage.

translations.source: Failed to update CMOS (file missing or not writable).
translations.translation: Échec mise à jour CMOS (absent/non inscriptible).

translations.source: Could not apply mouse profile (need a disc profile).
translations.translation: Profil souris non applicable (profil disque requis).

translations.source: Bound current EXP to disc profile.

translations.source: The selected CPU/model did not match the SYS ROM, so it was reset to an allowed value.
translations.translation: CPU/modèle incompatible avec la SYS ROM — réinitialisé à une valeur autorisée.

translations.source: Failed to create the FD image.
The file already exists. Overwrite it?
A disc profile is loaded for the mounted CD.
translations.translation: Profil disque chargé pour le CD.

translations.source: Mouse capture ON — list refresh / prune (profile paused). ESC to stop.
translations.translation: Capture ON — rafraîchir/élaguer (profil en pause). ESC pour arrêter.

translations.source: Mouse capture OFF — profile mouse mode restored.
translations.translation: Capture OFF — mode souris du profil restauré.

translations.source: Scan on — adding candidates (mouse capture ON). ESC to stop.
translations.translation: Scan ON — ajout de candidats (capture ON). ESC pour arrêter.

translations.source: Scan off — capture may stay on for prune.
translations.translation: Scan OFF — la capture peut rester pour élaguer.

translations.source: Check one X and one Y candidate, then Update.
translations.translation: Cochez un X et un Y, puis Update.

translations.source: Updated Mouse integration setting from selected X/Y.
translations.translation: Intégration souris mise à jour depuis X/Y.
Arrêté (ESC) — mode souris du profil restauré.

translations.source: Memory scan mouse capture is active. Press ESC to stop Scan and capture.
translations.translation: Capture du scan mémoire active. ESC arrête Scan et capture.

translations.source: App-specific Phys integration is active. Middle button switches to mouse capture; middle again restores.
translations.translation: Phys app actif. Clic milieu → capture ; encore → restauration.

translations.source: Mouse BIOS (MOS) integration is active. Middle button switches to mouse capture; middle again restores.
translations.translation: Intégration Mouse BIOS (MOS) active. Clic milieu → capture ; encore → restauration.

translations.source: Mouse capture is active. Press the middle mouse button to release capture.
translations.translation: Capture active. Clic milieu pour libérer.

translations.source: Mouse capture released. Press the middle mouse button to start capture; press it again to release.
translations.translation: Capture libre. Clic milieu pour capturer ; encore pour libérer.

translations.source: No resume state for the mounted CD (slot 0)
Clear Game Phys / Phys 2 / range / scale / invert / Bind. You can Apply or OK with Phys unset.
translations.translation: Clear Game Phys / Phys 2 / range / scale / invert / Bind. You can Apply or OK with Phys unset.

translations.source: Bind app-specific mouse integration to the latest DOS Load/Exec (INT 21H AH=4BH). Under DOS extenders (RUN386), bind the .EXP payload when shown.
translations.translation: Lier la souris app au dernier DOS Load/Exec (INT 21H AH=4BH). Sous extender (RUN386) : lier le .EXP affiché.

translations.source:
Open Memory scan to find guest RAM cursor coordinates.
Settings closes while the scan window is open.
translations.translation:
Ouvrir le scan mémoire pour les coords curseur.
Les paramètres se ferment pendant le scan.

translations.source:
Load a mouse-integration preset for this CD fingerprint.
Enabled when mouse_XXXXXXXX.ini is found. Apply or OK saves it to the disc profile.
translations.translation:
Charger un preset souris pour cette empreinte CD.
Actif si mouse_XXXXXXXX.ini existe. Appliquer/OK enregistre dans le profil.

translations.source:
Write the current app-specific mouse settings to
~/.config/townsqt/mouse_presets/mouse_XXXXXXXX.ini.
Enabled when app-specific Phys is set.
translations.translation:
Écrire les réglages souris app dans
~/.config/townsqt/mouse_presets/mouse_XXXXXXXX.ini.
Actif si Phys app défini.

translations.source: Offset from live DS.base (WC-style). Prefer this over absolute Phys when guest layout shifts with memory/CMOS/HDD changes.
translations.translation: Offset depuis DS.base live (WC). Préférer à Phys absolu si le layout change (RAM/CMOS/HDD).

translations.source: Optional second X/Y phys (below). Direct-write uses each row’s Scale on store; game-feedback uses Scale on host in Δ. Min/max are direct-write only.
translations.translation: Optional second X/Y phys (below). Direct-write uses each row’s Scale on store; game-feedback uses Scale on host in Δ. Min/max are direct-write only.

translations.source: Direct-write: multiplies the mapped store value. Game-feedback: multiplies host in Δ (0 = no multiply).
translations.translation: Direct-write: multiplies the mapped store value. Game-feedback: multiplies host in Δ (0 = no multiply).

translations.source:
On: poke Game Phys in guest RAM (min/max clamp + scale on store).
Off: gameport Δ = (host × scale) − guest (1:1 raw coords; min/max unused).
translations.translation:
On: poke Game Phys in guest RAM (min/max clamp + scale on store).
Off: gameport Δ = (host × scale) − guest (1:1 raw coords; min/max unused).

translations.source: Wait for gameport input to apply

When on, hold the next gameport packet until Phys updates or the port is idle. Turn off for continuous refill (may oscillate on delayed guest feedback). Only used for gameport mode (memory write off).
translations.translation: On : retenir le paquet gameport jusqu’à Phys/idle. Off : refill continu (peut osciller). Mode gameport seulement.

translations.source: Stop writing to Mouse BIOS soft-cursor phys
When on, do not write Mouse BIOS soft coordinates while MOS is alive. Game Phys / gameport still follow app-specific settings.
translations.translation: On : ne pas écrire soft Mouse BIOS tant que MOS vit. Game Phys/gameport suivent encore les réglages app.

translations.source: Default (priority): app-specific Phys when set and bound → Mouse BIOS (MOS) while alive → mouse capture otherwise. Middle button toggles mouse capture on/off (no click-to-capture). Set Game Phys / Bind for app-specific integration.
translations.translation: Défaut (priorité) : Phys app si défini+lié → Mouse BIOS (MOS) vivant → sinon capture. Clic milieu bascule capture (pas de clic-pour-capturer). App : Game Phys / Bind.

translations.source: Mouse capture (failsafe): always uses mouse capture. Middle button enables or releases capture. Mouse integration is not performed.
translations.translation: Capture (failsafe) : toujours capture. Clic milieu on/off. Pas d’intégration souris.

translations.source:
Scan RAM for new coordinate candidates (also turns Mouse capture ON).
Move the mouse in the emu view.  ESC stops Scan and capture.
translations.translation:
Scanner la RAM pour des candidats (capture ON).
Bouger la souris dans l’emu. ESC arrête Scan et capture.

translations.source:
Alone: refresh list values and drop unrelated candidates (no new Scan picks).
Forced while Scan is on.  Press again or ESC restores the profile mouse mode.
translations.translation:
Seul : rafraîchir et élaguer (pas de nouveaux).
Forcé pendant Scan. Encore ou ESC restaure le mode profil.

translations.source:
Reset observed min..max on all candidates.
Starts again from the next sampled value.
translations.translation:
Réinitialiser min..max observés.
Reprend au prochain échantillon.

translations.source: Delete rows with none of Watch / Chase / X / Y / X2 / Y2 checked.
translations.translation: Supprimer les lignes sans Watch / Chase / X / Y / X2 / Y2.

translations.source:
Copy the checked X/Y pair (and min..max) into Mouse integration.
If X2/Y2 are also checked, fill Phys 2 as well.
Closes Memory scan and reopens Settings. Does not save — use Apply or OK there.
translations.translation:
Copier le couple X/Y (et min..max) vers intégration souris.
X2/Y2 → Phys 2 aussi.
Ferme le scan et rouvre Paramètres. Ne sauve pas — Appliquer/OK là-bas.

translations.source: Close Memory scan and return to Settings → Mouse integration.
translations.translation: Fermer le scan → Paramètres → Intégr. souris.

translations.source:
Scan = add candidates (turns Mouse capture ON).
Mouse capture ON alone = refresh values / prune noise (no new picks).
Watch = keep in list after Scan stops.
Chase = follow guest-writer SOURCE; moves to the new SOURCE when found.
Also adds nearby phys (±32 bytes) whose value Δ matches host/IO mouse Δ.
X/Y = primary Game Phys pair.  X2/Y2 = optional Phys 2 pair.
Green phys = MOS soft-cursor words (writable if set as Phys).
Blue phys = disc-profile pair.  span = max−min; oversized rows are pruned.
ESC ends capture (+ Scan).
translations.translation:
Scan = candidats (capture ON).
Capture seule = rafraîchir/élaguer.
Watch = garder après Scan.
Chase = suivre SOURCE.
Phys proches (±32) si Δ mouse.
X/Y = Game Phys. X2/Y2 = Phys 2.
Vert = MOS soft-cursor. Bleu = profil. span = max−min.
ESC finit capture (+ Scan).

translations.source:
Delete the disc profile "%1"?
Per-disc machine and mouse settings will be removed.
This cannot be undone.
translations.translation:
Supprimer le profil « %1 » ?
Réglages machine/souris du disque seront effacés.
Irréversible.

translations.source:
Editing Basics defaults (townsqt.conf). Apply or OK saves here.
Memory, boot drive, and CPU fidelity changes restart the emulator; game-port changes apply immediately.
Create a disc profile when a CD is mounted to save per-disc settings
(FD0 / FD1 / HD0–HD6 mounts, and CMOS under cmos/cmos_XXXXXXXX.bin).
translations.translation:
Éditer les defaults Base (townsqt.conf). Appliquer/OK enregistre ici.
Mémoire, boot et fidélité CPU redémarrent ; gameport immédiat.
Avec un CD, créez un profil pour réglages par disque
(FD0/FD1/HD0–HD6, CMOS dans cmos/cmos_XXXXXXXX.bin).

translations.source:
Edits the active CMOS (global cmos.bin or profile cmos/cmos_XXXXXXXX.bin).
Apply or OK updates VM CMOS RAM and the file. Towns OS usually needs reset/boot.
translations.translation:
CMOS active (cmos.bin global ou profil cmos/cmos_XXXXXXXX.bin).
Appliquer/OK met à jour CMOS RAM et fichier. Towns OS : souvent reset/boot.

translations.source: Use sinc interpolation for PCM resampling
Without sinc interpolation, linear interpolation is used.
Changes take effect immediately when you press Apply or OK.
translations.translation: Effet immédiat avec Appliquer ou OK.

translations.source:
When a disc profile exists for the mounted CD image, automatically save
per-disc state save slot 0 (state0_XXXXXXXX.TState) on CD eject and app exit,
and auto-resume on the next load. Manual restart with the same CD does not
load a saved state. When off, state saves are neither auto-written nor auto-loaded.
translations.translation:
Avec profil disque : sauver le slot 0 (state0_XXXXXXXX.TState) à l’éjection CD et à la sortie,
auto-resume au prochain chargement. Redémarrage manuel du même CD : pas de state.
Off : pas d’auto save/load.

translations.source: Mouse BIOS integration that writes guest memory to reduce latency.
translations.translation: Intégration Mouse BIOS écrivant la RAM (moins de latence).

translations.source:
Bulk-prefetch the CDDA audio track and keep playing through data reads
without interrupting playback. The value is how many seconds until
playback is considered finished.
translations.translation:
Précharger la piste CDDA et continuer pendant les lectures data.
Valeur = secondes avant fin de lecture.

translations.source: Prevents automatic screen blanking/dimming on Wayland sessions.
Available only on sessions that support Wayland idle-inhibit.

Editing the disc profile (fp_XXXXXXXX.ini, amber block).
Apply or OK saves clock, boot drive, memory, ports, options,
and FD0 / FD1 / HD0–HD6 mount state to the profile (restored on next load).
CMOS (drive letters, single drive) uses cmos/cmos_XXXXXXXX.bin for this disc — set in Towns SETUP.
CPU and model stay global in townsqt.conf and are not stored in the profile.
Memory, boot drive, and CPU fidelity changes restart the emulator.
translations.translation:
Éditer le profil (fp_XXXXXXXX.ini, ambre).
Appliquer/OK sauve horloge, boot, mémoire, ports, options
et montages FD0/FD1/HD0–HD6.
CMOS : cmos/cmos_XXXXXXXX.bin — Towns SETUP.
CPU/modèle restent globaux (townsqt.conf).
Mémoire/boot/fidélité → redémarrage.

translations.source:
No disc profile for this CD yet. Use Create profile to save per-disc settings
(including FD0, FD1, and HD0–HD6 mount state for restore).
A profile also gets its own CMOS file (cmos/cmos_XXXXXXXX.bin) for Towns SETUP.
Until then, Apply or OK saves Basics defaults to townsqt.conf.
Memory, boot drive, and CPU fidelity changes restart the emulator; game-port changes apply immediately.
translations.translation:
Pas encore de profil. « Créer profil » pour réglages par disque
(FD0/FD1/HD0–HD6).
Le profil a son CMOS (cmos/cmos_XXXXXXXX.bin).
Sinon Appliquer/OK sauve la Base dans townsqt.conf.
Mémoire/boot/fidélité → redémarrage ; gameport immédiat.
Pas de profil pour ce disque.
